en.headline: 4 commits on sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu; 3 issues opened on openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-03, sogeisetsu made 4 own commits to sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu, plus 2 additional automated commits by github-actions[bot]. The commits introduced a daily GitHub activity report rendered on GitHub Pages with SenseTime AI, switched the report to a rolling 2-hour update cadence with more detailed summaries and display fixes, corrected the report's commit-counting wording and page issues, and added workflow_dispatch support so the daily-report workflow can be triggered with a specific date. No pull requests or reviews were recorded. On openchamber/openchamber, 3 issues were opened: #4337 (docs still pointing to a removed sidebar header button, later closed by btriapitsyn), #4345 (command palette 'Parallel run' sharing the checkbox-multiple icon with sidebar 'Select sessions'), and #4346 (SidebarHeader.test.tsx still passing after onOpenMultiRun/canOpenMultiRun were removed in d9fbf6b). openchamber-bot[bot] replied on #4337 and #4345, marking both as fix-ready with traced causes.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 4 次提交；openchamber 新开 3 个 issue
zh.summary: 2026-10-03，sogeisetsu 在 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 完成 4 次本人提交，另有 2 次由 github-actions[bot] 自动提交。这些提交新增了基于 GitHub Pages 与商汤 AI 的每日 GitHub 活动日报，将日报改为每 2 小时滚动更新并补充更详细的摘要与若干显示修复，修正了日报的提交口径与页面问题，并为日报工作流增加了 workflow_dispatch 手动指定日期的支持。当日无 PR 与 review 记录。在 openchamber/openchamber 上共新开 3 个 issue：#4337（多运行文档仍指向 d9fbf6b 中已移除的侧边栏头部按钮，随后由 btriapitsyn 关闭）、#4345（命令面板的 'Parallel run' 与侧边栏 'Select sessions' 共用 checkbox-multiple 图标）、#4346（在 d9fbf6b 移除 onOpenMultiRun/canOpenMultiRun 后 SidebarHeader.test.tsx 仍通过）。openchamber-bot[bot] 在 #4337 与 #4345 上回复，将两者标记为 fix-ready 并给出原因追踪。
